read_only_auto.description: Read-only, non-mutating, low-risk. Executes automatically without human approval (still logged + trace).

manual_approval.description: Mutating or risky. Requires explicit human approval before any execution. Dry-run is mandatory first.
examples: write to LabOps workspace output files
read excluded data (train/test CSV, private labels, keys, secrets)
modify/delete project snapshot or any allowed file

auto_approval_conditions.note: An action may auto-run only if ALL hold

manual_approval_requirements.note: An action may proceed only if ALL hold

timeout_rules.approval_timeout_action: MARK TIMEOUT (first-class state); incident stays BLOCKED; action NOT executed
timeout_rules.action_timeout_action: KILL action; mark action TIMEOUT; verification NOT_VERIFIED; incident BLOCKED

blocked_rules.missing_evidence: hypothesis -> BLOCKED/UNKNOWN; no action; request evidence; incident stays BLOCKED
blocked_rules.approval_rejected: hypothesis -> REJECTED; action SKIPPED; incident BLOCKED (recorded closure REJECTED)
blocked_rules.verification_failed: incident BLOCKED; require remediation before retry

closure_rule.rule: An incident CLOSES only when verification status == PASSED for its required actions, OR when explicitly closed as REJECTED/UNVERIFIED with reason recorded.

polar_baseline_mapping_examples.note: Illustrative mapping of real evidence gaps to approval classes (grounded in evidence_gaps.json)

examples.action: download data (SIMULATED in demo; no real download)
record as UNKNOWN; do NOT assert documented BER as fact
never read/never request private test labels

demo_principle_guard.missing_evidence_recorded_as: UNKNOWN or BLOCKED (never asserted as fact)
